_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d5; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint D1. requiredEvidence = must all be selected (and known) to confirm; supportingEvidence = may also be selected without breaking the deduction. Every wrong conclusion is ruled out by a card. closeHint (B1) = a reasoning nudge shown under the closeness line when the player picks wrongConclusions[closeHint.wrong]; it never names a card.

deductions.question: Who rang the village bell at 2:17?
deductions.requiredDescription: Rope never moved; every clock at 2:17; lantern resonance.
deductions.conclusion: The Echo Lantern network rang it. No hand touched the rope.
wrongConclusions: Mira rang the bell herself to warn the village.
A villager pulled the rope and fled before anyone saw.

closeHint.text: A bell can ring without a rope.

deductions.unlockText: Unlock clock-tower basement and first corrected timeline note.
deductions.reaction: The bell was never the warning. It was the broadcast.

deductions.question: Why do witness memories show different times?
deductions.requiredDescription: Networked clocks at 2:17; Mira's own watch at 2:31.
deductions.conclusion: 2:17 is when the network froze the clocks. The night went on.
wrongConclusions: The clocks were simply broken. Nothing happened after 2:17.
The later entry is a mistake. Every clock was right.

closeHint.text: Broken clocks don't all stop on the same minute.

deductions.reaction: If time was edited, someone edited it on purpose.

deductions.question: Who is the figure with the staff?
deductions.requiredDescription: Apprentice staff at Nia's door; Nia gone by 2:31.
deductions.conclusion: Veyra's lantern apprentice. He took Nia from the sickroom.
wrongConclusions: The figure was a stranger passing through Veyra.
The figure was Leela, carrying her own staff.
deductions.reaction: An apprentice's staff, and a name scraped off the page.

deductions.question: Why did the river disappear?
deductions.requiredDescription: Full current at 2:10; sluice drains to the lantern-house.
deductions.conclusion: The emergency sluice drained it into the lantern's channels.
wrongConclusions: A long drought dried the river weeks before.
The villagers dammed the river upstream.

closeHint.text: Droughts take weeks. This took minutes.

deductions.reaction: The river did not vanish. It was sent somewhere.

deductions.question: When did Arun actually see the figure?
deductions.requiredDescription: Watch ran 2:17 to 2:31; footsteps minutes after the bell.
deductions.conclusion: Between 2:17 and 2:31. The night went on after the clocks stopped.
wrongConclusions: Arun saw the figure before the clocks stopped.
Arun's watch ran fast. He saw nothing after 2:17.

closeHint.text: Which came first, the bell or the footsteps?

deductions.reaction: The night kept moving after the clocks stopped.

deductions.question: Who was the walker carrying?
deductions.requiredDescription: Nia's hairclip on the coat; footsteps toward the lantern-house.
deductions.conclusion: Nia Vane, carried across the dry river to the lantern-house.
wrongConclusions: A stranger's child, carried away from the flood.
Nia, carried away from the lantern-house to safety.

closeHint.text: Follow the footsteps. Which way were they going?

deductions.unlockText: Unlock Nia's medical record and motive clue.
deductions.reaction: Nobody was rescued that night. She was being taken to the machine.

deductions.question: What can the Echo Lantern actually do?
deductions.requiredDescription: Spool records, extracts, transfers; 32 anchor nodes.
deductions.conclusion: It can extract, store and transfer memories, and bind multiple minds as anchors.
wrongConclusions: It is only a lamp for reading old records.
It can show memories, but it can never take them.

closeHint.text: Read what the spool says it does.

deductions.reaction: A lamp that could hold a whole village. And someone lit it.

deductions.question: Why were the memories altered?
deductions.requiredDescription: Purge keyed to the apprentice staff; operator E. Vane.
deductions.conclusion: Elias ran a self-purge. His name, face and record were erased from Veyra.
wrongConclusions: Ten years of grief wore the memories away.
Leela edited the records to hide her trials on Nia.

closeHint.text: Whose key does the purge answer to?

deductions.reaction: The missing pieces were not missing. Someone removed them. Carefully.

deductions.question: What caused the mass disappearance?
deductions.requiredDescription: Operator E. Vane opened 32 nodes; Nia's trials failed.
deductions.conclusion: Elias opened every node to save Nia. The village became her anchors.
wrongConclusions: A storm struck the tower and overloaded the network.
Leela connected every node and lost control.

closeHint.text: She wrote the rule. Who broke it?

deductions.reaction: Elias Vane did this. Then he walked out of Veyra.
